baseline: Stage 7 venue-results model and fixed-rate Poisson, with expected-points picks

evaluation.primary: Mean exact-score log loss on common untouched chronological rounds, probability floor 1e-15
evaluation.training: Dixon–Coles uses only whole rounds with all results available strictly before the forecast deadline. Competition means and opponent PPG use point-in-time pre-deadline matches only.
evaluation.interpretation: Review only after 20 eligible paired holdouts. Report all five candidates and paired 95% round-bootstrap intervals. No automatic promotion.
